title: orchis incarnata subsp. ochroleuca
intro: Orchis incarnata subsp. ochroleuca, commonly known as the pale green helleborine, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of pale green helleborine are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antitumor activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential applications in pharmaceuticals.
